parameters.description:
Aion RP LLaMA 3.1 8B is a reasoning-optimized 8B model from Aion Labs, tuned for text generation, coding, and rich conversational flows.

Released in July 2025 and built on Meta's LLaMA 3.1 (8B parameters), it is fine-tuned by Aion Labs for structured reasoning, code assistance, function calling, and long-context understanding up to 32K tokens. It is served OpenAI-compatibly through the UnitySVC gateway, which relays your chat-completion requests to the AionLabs API and meters usage per token.

Call it in either the OpenAI or Anthropic API style — the gateway auto-detects the dialect and translates as needed. Two channels share one endpoint: `managed` (pay per token using the platform's key, nothing to configure) and `byok` (bring your own AionLabs key and route free). See the code examples and "How to use this model" for setup.

details.coding: Strong performance on code completion and debugging tasks
details.function_calling: Supports API-based function calling for tool use
details.multimodal: Not multimodal — optimized for text-only tasks
details.reasoning: Enhanced structured reasoning and step-by-step problem solving
